PatientProfile.title: PatientProfile
PatientProfile.description: Stores a patient's personal details (name, age, height, weight, known diseases/medications, email, phone), primary therapeutic condition, active conditions, baseline scores, and Ayurvedic dietary preference.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this profile.

knownDiseasesOrMedications.description: Known medical conditions, comorbidities, or current medications (0 to 300 characters).

emailId.description: Patient email address / mail ID (0 to 120 characters).

phoneNumber.description: Patient contact phone number (0 to 30 characters).

primaryConditionId.description: Primary disease/condition ID targeted for recovery.

activeConditionIds.description: List of condition IDs tracked by the patient (max 10).

baselinePainScore.description: Initial baseline pain level from 0 to 10.

baselineMobilityScore.description: Initial baseline mobility level from 1 to 10.

baselineStressScore.description: Initial baseline stress/anxiety level from 0 to 10.

dailyGoalMinutes.description: Daily therapeutic practice target in minutes (5 to 180).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

RecoveryLog.title: RecoveryLog
RecoveryLog.description: Daily patient recovery check-in tracking pain, stiffness, stress, mobility, sleep, completed yoga therapy minutes, and dietary adherence.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this recovery log.

conditionId.description: Condition ID evaluated in this daily log.

dateLabel.description: ISO date string or human-readable date label (1 to 30 chars).

asanaMinutes.description: Minutes of therapeutic Asana practiced today (0 to 240).

pranayamaMinutes.description: Minutes of Pranayama breathwork practiced today (0 to 240).

dhyanaMinutes.description: Minutes of Dhyana meditation practiced today (0 to 240).

completedPractices.description: List of completed practice IDs or names (max 30).

dietAdherenceScore.description: Percentage adherence to disease-specific diet guidelines (0 to 100).

waterIntakeGlasses.description: Hydration intake in glasses of warm/herbal water (0 to 25).

notes.description: Optional patient reflections or symptom triggers (0 to 500 chars).

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PracticeSession.title: PracticeSession
PracticeSession.description: Individual guided Asana, Pranayama, or Dhyana therapy session completed by the patient.

conditionId.description: Condition ID targeted by the session.

practiceId.description: Unique identifier of the Asana, Pranayama, or Dhyana.

practiceTitle.description: Title of the therapeutic practice (1 to 100 chars).

/users/{userId}.description: Patient profile, anthropometrics, medical history, and baseline condition configuration.

/users/{userId}/recovery_logs/{logId}.description: Daily patient recovery and symptom progress logs.

/users/{userId}/practice_sessions/{sessi.description: Completed guided Asana, Pranayama, and Dhyana sessions.
